[P1] 不一样的卡梅拉
当当网终身五星级童书
★★★★★
我去找回太阳
〔法〕克利斯提昂·约里波瓦/文 〔法〕克利斯提昂·艾利施/图
郑迪蔚/译
不一样的卡梅拉
畅销300万册

[P2] 早上，太阳还没升起来，小公鸡和小母鸡们就已经醒了。
小六子、小胖墩、鼻涕虫、小刺头、娇气包……憋足了劲齐声喊：“1,2,3！冲啊！”
小鸡们嘻嘻哈哈一齐冲进爸爸、妈妈温暖的被窝。

[P3] “喂，喂！爸爸，妈妈！给我们让个位子！”
“呀，这里真暖和呀！”

早上的撒娇可真够热闹的！

卡门和卡梅利多也钻进卡梅拉的怀里，“嗯，妈妈也给我让个位子呀！”
卡梅拉拉开热被窝，将他们搂在翅膀下面，就像小时候一样。

[P4] 爸爸皮迪克早就开始了每天的工作——叫醒太阳。

卡门趴在窗户上，崇拜地望着站在草垛顶上的父亲：“爸爸，你太伟大了！”
皮迪克庄重地仰着头，他的嗓音既高亢又浑厚，还圆润、有力。
喔喔喔喔喔喔！

啊，奇迹出现了！
一轮红日随着皮迪克的打鸣声，
从天边冉冉升起。

爸爸，爸爸！

[P5] 太阳，是我爸爸叫醒的！

[P6] “等我长大了，我也要指挥太阳！”卡门说。

“胡说八道！”小胖墩嘲笑说，“别忘了你是一个小女生！只有公鸡才能让太阳升起来！”

第二天，天空布满了乌云。
无论皮迪克怎么努力，也没能把太阳叫醒……更糟的是，还下起了大雨。

“别担心，爸爸！你会成功的！”

[P7] 几个小时过去了，几天过去了……太阳就好像聋了一样。
连续两个星期，都不见太阳的踪影。
6月18日这天，皮迪克还照常啼鸣，他用世界上所有的语言呼唤太阳——
英语：cock-a-doodle!
西班牙语：QUIQUIRIKI!
俄语：KOU-KA-RÉ-KOU!
汉语：喔喔！
爱尔兰语：CUC-a-dudat-du!
日语：Kou Kou Kou Kou!
意大利语：CHICHIRICHI!
德语：KIKERIKI!
……可是，这全都不管用。

[P8] {
  "raw_extracted_text": "到了月底,还是见
不到太阳……














































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































[P9] “佩罗，你最有学问，快想想办法吧！这样下去怎么办呀？”卡门和卡梅利多把希望都寄托在佩罗身上了。
“你们要知道，我的孩子！”佩罗解释道，“太阳其实是天上的一个巨大无边的蛋黄……”
“当我们看不到它的时候……
那是它已经煮熟了！”
“佩罗变成老糊涂了！所有人都知道，太阳是一个用煤气燃烧的大火球。”小卡门很失望。

[P10] 鸡舍里正在策划一场阴谋政变：
“皮迪克老啦，他不行了！”小胖墩宣布说，“顶替
他的时候到了。”
“对，说得对，不行就下来！”
“走！我们这就去草垛那儿把他轰下来！”
“伙伴们，我真的病了，我走不动。”鼻涕虫
觉得外面太冷，便找借口不去。

[P11] 这天早上，皮迪克又失败了。
卡门和卡梅利多非常难过。
“快点！离开这里！快滚开！”
“让皮迪克先生看看我们的本事！”
“你们的爸爸已经老了！太阳还能听见老头的喊声吗？哈哈！”小胖墩嘲笑道。
“不许你这么说我爸爸！”卡梅利多愤怒地扑向小胖墩，他们在雨地里扭打了起来。
砰！嘭！
卡门最讨厌小公鸡们打架了，她拿起木棍，决定让这场争斗快点结束……

[P12] “卡门，如果不是你插手，我就被……”
“嘿嘿，幸好没把你的嘴打歪。”
“喂，贝里奥，咱们一起去找太阳吧！”
“你们俩等我一下，我马上就回来。”
咔嚓！
“向日葵，听听这名字就知道，它的脑袋总是朝着太阳的，我们只要跟着这朵花指出的方向，就一定能找到太阳！”
“贝里奥，真没想到，我这个妹妹，小小年纪就知道这么多事……”

[P13] “男子汉们，走呀！”
“我认为太阳一定是病了。”
“对！我生病的时候也要卧床休息。”
“它这么久不起床，一定是得了很严重的病，哎呀，等我们找到它的时候，没准儿已经死了，那可怎么办？”
天空还是阴雨绵绵。
在向日葵的指引下，贝里奥、卡门和卡梅利多，
到处寻找太阳可能躲藏的地方：田野、草地、树林，
连小山洞也没放过……

[P14] 直到有一天……

“快看！”卡门大喊着，“向日葵指向柯尔贝大磨坊！”
“你们好，朋友们！”正在唱歌玩耍的鸭子柯尔贝，热情地向三个冒险家打招呼。

“哇，持续了一个月的阴雨天！这是我们鸭子最快乐的日子。”
嘎嘎嘎！啦啦啦！
“来吧，朋友们！我们一起唱歌跳舞吧！”

我在雨中唱歌……

雨中唱歌多快乐……
“对不起，柯尔贝，我们可没什么心思唱。”卡梅利多说。

“我们在寻找太阳。”
“如果明天还找不到太阳，爸爸就会失去他的工作！”

[P15] “太阳？太——阳！”柯尔贝突然想起了什么，
“对，太阳它就在楼上！跟我来，我带你们去。”

“这是蒙特哥菲尔兄弟生产纸张的厂房。”

“要这么多纸做什么？”贝里奥问。

“用来写点鸡同鸭讲的话呗！”

他脑子进
水了吧！

[P16] 他们尾随着柯尔贝，悄悄穿过蒙特哥菲尔兄弟的卧室。

“啊！糟了！工作室的门锁上了。”

“别慌，我们从这个小洞钻进去！”

“瞧！就在这儿。”柯尔贝神气地说，
“我没有骗你们吧。”

[P17] “原来太阳藏在这儿啦！”三个小伙伴赶紧奔向“受困的太阳”。

“啊！它还活着呢！瞧，它看见我们有多高兴！”

“来，咱们赶紧把太阳救出去！1、2、3……”

[P18] 埃蒂安被嘈杂声吵醒：“约瑟夫，有只小粉鸡正在偷你的发明！”

“一只小粉鸡！哦，是吗？埃蒂安，别胡思乱想了，快回去睡觉吧！我们明天还有很多事情要做呢。”

[P19] 气球慢慢地膨胀，鼓得又大又圆，它缓缓地向天空升去，好壮观啊！

[P20] “太阳”带着小鸡、小鸭和小绵羊离开了陆地！
他们当然不知道，这是人类历史上第一次气球载动物飞行！
“那些羊怎么会在天上呢？”贝里奥好奇地问。
“傻瓜，那是白云。”卡门说，“看这里，
人们常说地球是圆的，看来是真的……”
看，我们的家！

[P21] 鸡舍旁，卡梅拉陪着心情非常沉重的丈夫，去做最后一次尝试。
卡梅拉一再鼓励他要镇静，但皮迪克已经信心不足了，他颤巍巍地爬上草垛，满身大汗。
所有的鸡在雨中站成一排，这是皮迪克的最后一次机会。
“切！他不会成功的！”有人幸灾乐祸地预测。
在一片寂静中，皮迪克用尽平生之力，
昂首向天空发出一声鸣叫。
喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔

[P22] 太阳出来了！我成功了！！

啊！！哎哟……

……这时，真正的太阳也升了起来。

[P23] 这是个阳光明媚的早晨。
生活真美好啊！皮迪克抱起他的两个宝贝，美滋滋地
往回走，造反的小公鸡们，灰溜溜地在一旁生闷气。

一个月来，太阳一直照耀着鸡舍，小
鸡们又找回了生活中的乐趣。

卡门还发明了一个有趣的找太阳游戏：
1……2……3……看太阳！

[P24] 而蒙特哥菲尔兄弟俩天天都在没完没了地争吵：
“约瑟夫，我发誓，当时告诉过你有只小粉鸡，还
有一只绵羊和一只鸭子……”

“别找借口了，埃蒂安，用力打气！”，

[P1] 不一样的卡梅拉

★★★★★
I Go to Find the Sun
〔France〕Christian Jolibois / Text 〔France〕Christian Heinrich / Illustrations
Zheng Diwei / Translator
不一样的卡梅拉
Bestseller 3 million copies sold

[P2] In the morning, before the sun had risen, the little roosters and hens were already awake.
Little Liu Zi, Fat墩, Snotbug, Spiky Head, and Prissy... all strained and shouted together: "1, 2, 3! Charge!"
The little chicks laughed and rushed into their dad and mom's warm nest.

[P3] "Hey, hey! Dad, Mom! Let us have a spot!"
"Oh, it's so warm here!"

The morning cuddling is really lively!

Carmen and Caramel also crawl into Camille's arms, "Hmm, Mom, give me a spot too!"
Camille pulls open the warm nest and hugs them under her wings, just like when they were little.

[P4] Dad Pidik had already started his daily job—waking up the sun.

Kamen lay by the window, admiring her father standing on top of the haystack: "Dad, you're so great!"
Pidik raised his head solemnly; his voice was both high and deep, rich and powerful.
Cock-a-doodle-doo!

Ah, a miracle appeared!
A red sun rose slowly from the horizon, following Pidik's crowing.

Dad, Dad!

[P5] The sun? My dad woke it up!

[P6] "When I grow up, I'll command the sun too!" said Camille.

"Nonsense!" chuckled Little Fat, "Don't forget you're a little girl! Only roosters can make the sun rise!"

The next day, the sky was filled with dark clouds.
No matter how hard Pidik tried, he couldn't wake the sun... and worse still, it started raining.

"Don't worry, Dad! You'll succeed!"

[P7] Several hours passed, then several days... the sun seemed as if it had gone deaf.
For two straight weeks, there was no sign of the sun.
On June 18th, Pidik still crowed as usual, calling out to the sun in languages from all over the world—
English: cock-a-doodle!
Spanish: QUIQUIRIKI!
Russian: KOU-KA-RÉ-KOU!
Chinese:喔喔！
Irish: CUC-a-dudat-du!
Japanese: Kou Kou Kou Kou!
Italian: CHICHIRICHI!
German: KIKERIKI!
...But none of it worked.

[P9] "Pero, you're the most knowledgeable, think of a solution quickly! What are we going to do?" Carmen and Camille put all their hope on Pero.
"You need to know, my children!" Pero explained, "The sun is actually a gigantic yolk in the sky..."
"When we can't see it... 
it's already boiled!"
"Pero has turned into a senile old fool! Everyone knows the sun is a big fireball burning with gas." Little Carmen was very disappointed.

[P10] Inside the chicken coop, a coup was being planned:
"P迪克 is old, he's no good anymore!" announced Little Fat, "It's time to replace him."
"Right, you're right, if he can't do it, he should step down!"
"Let's go! We'll go to the haystack and kick him down!"
"Fellows, I'm really sick, I can't move." Snotbug
felt too cold outside and made an excuse not to go.

[P11] This morning, Pidik failed again.
Carmen and Camille were very sad.
"Hurry up! Get out of here! Get lost!"
"Let Mr. Pidik see what we can do!"
"Your dad is already old! Can the sun still hear an old man's call? Haha!" laughed Little Fat.
"Don't talk about my dad like that!" Camille angrily lunged at Little Fat, and they started wrestling in the rain.
Bang! Thud!
Carmen hated it when the little roosters fought. She picked up a stick and decided to end this fight quickly...

[P12] "Carmen, if it weren't for you stepping in, I'd have been..."
"Hehe, luckily I didn't knock your beak crooked."
"Hey, Bélier, let's go find the sun together!"
"You two wait for me a moment, I'll be right back."
Crack!
"Sunflower, just from its name you can tell, its head always faces the sun. If we follow the direction this flower points, we're sure to find the sun!"
"Bélier, I never thought my little sister, at such a young age, would know so much..."

[P13] "Boys, let's go!"
"I think the sun must be sick."
"Right! When I'm sick, I have to rest in bed."
"It hasn't gotten up for so long, it must have a very serious illness. Oh dear, by the time we find it, it might already be dead. What then?"
It was still raining heavily.
Guided by the sunflowers, Bélier, Carmen, and Camille
searched everywhere for places where the sun might be hiding: fields, meadows, forests,
even small caves weren't left out...

[P14] Until one day...

"Look!" cried Carmen, "The sunflower is pointing to Corbeau's Mill!"
"Hello, friends!" said the duck Corbeau, who was singing and playing, warmly greeting the three adventurers.

"Wow, a whole month of rainy weather! This is the happiest time for us ducks."
Quack quack! La la la!
"Come on, friends! Let's sing and dance together!"

I'm singing in the rain...

Singing in the rain is so much fun...
"Sorry, Corbeau, we don't really feel like singing," said Camembert.

"We are looking for the sun."
"If we don't find the sun by tomorrow, Dad will lose his job!"

[P15] "Sun? Sun!" Kolbe suddenly remembered something,
"Right, the sun is upstairs! Follow me, I'll take you there."

"This is the factory where the Montgolfier brothers produce paper."

"What are we going to do with all this paper?" Berio asked.

"To write some chicken-and-duck talk, of course!"

His brain must be flooded with water!

[P16] They followed Kolbe, quietly passing through the Montgolfier brothers' bedroom.

"Ah! Oh no! The workshop door is locked!"

"Don't worry, we'll crawl through this little hole!"

"Look! Right here," Kolbe said proudly,
"I didn't deceive you, did I?"

[P17] "The sun is hidden here!" The three companions hurried towards the "trapped sun".

"Ah! It's still alive! Look, how happy it is to see us!"

"Come on, let's quickly rescue the sun! 1, 2, 3..."

[P18] Etienne was awakened by the noise: "Joseph, a little pink chicken is stealing your invention!"

"A little pink chicken! Oh, really? Etienne, don't be silly, go back to sleep! We have many things to do tomorrow."

[P19] The balloon slowly inflated, swelling big and round, as it gently rose into the sky—what a magnificent sight!

[P20] "The Sun" carried the chicks, ducklings, and little sheep away from the land!
They certainly didn't know this was the first time in human history that animals had flown in a balloon!
"How can those sheep be up in the sky?" asked Berio curiously.
"Fool, those are clouds," said Carmen. "Look here, people always say the Earth is round — it seems to be true..."
Look, our home!

[P21] By the chicken coop, Camille accompanied her husband, who was deeply distressed, for one last attempt.
Camille kept encouraging him to stay calm, but Pidik had lost his confidence. He trembled as he climbed onto the haystack, drenched in sweat.
All the chickens stood in a line in the rain. This was Pidik's final chance.
"Ha! He won't succeed!" someone predicted with glee.
In silence, Pidik summoned all his strength,
and raised his head to the sky, letting out a single cry.
Cock-a-doodle-doo! Cock-a-doodle-doo! Cock-a-doodle-doo!

[P22] The sun is out! I did it!!

Ah!! Oh no...

...At that moment, the real sun rose as well.

[P23] It was a bright and sunny morning.
Life was wonderful! Pidik carried his two little ones, happily walking back, while the rebellious roosters sulked nearby.

For a month, the sun had been shining on the chicken coop, and the chicks had found joy in life again.

Carmen also invented a fun game to find the sun:
1……2……3……Look at the sun!

[P24] The Montgolfier brothers were arguing endlessly every day:
"Joseph, I swear, I told you before there was a little pink chicken, and also a sheep and a duck..."

"Stop making excuses, Etienne, pump harder!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我去找回太阳》的封面，展示了主角小鸡卡梅拉和朋友们在农场的场景，背景是蓝天和向日葵，右下角标注畅销300万册。
[P2] 清晨，太阳还未升起，小鸡们已经醒来，齐声喊着口号，嘻嘻哈哈地冲进爸爸妈妈温暖的被窝。
[P3] 小鸡们挤进父母的被窝撒娇，卡门和卡梅利多也钻进妈妈卡梅拉的怀里，享受温暖的早晨时光。
[P4] 爸爸皮迪克通过打鸣叫醒太阳，小鸡卡门崇拜地看着父亲，其他小鸡也兴奋地跑向他，庆祝太阳升起。
[P5] 小鸡们在草地上欢呼，指着雄赳赳的公鸡爸爸，骄傲地宣称是他叫醒了太阳。
[P6] 卡门表达了长大后要指挥太阳的愿望，但被小胖墩嘲笑；第二天，爸爸皮迪克努力打鸣却未能叫醒太阳，反而下起了大雨，卡门鼓励爸爸不要放弃。
[P7] 皮迪克在连续两个星期不见太阳的情况下，尝试用世界各种语言打鸣呼唤太阳，但最终毫无作用，太阳依然没有出现。
[P9] 小鸡们向智慧的佩罗求助，希望他能解决太阳不见的问题。佩罗解释太阳是巨大的蛋黄，当看不见时就是煮熟了，但小卡门对此表示失望，认为太阳是用煤气燃烧的火球。
[P10] 鸡舍里，小鸡们策划推翻公鸡爸爸皮迪克，小胖墩带头鼓动，而鼻涕虫则以生病为由拒绝参与，画面展现了雨中鸡舍内外的场景。
[P11] 皮迪克再次未能叫醒太阳，小鸡们对父亲失去信心并嘲笑他，卡梅利多愤怒地与小胖墩扭打，卡门则拿起木棍准备制止争斗。
[P12] 在雨中，小鸡们决定寻找太阳，卡门建议跟随向日葵的方向，贝里奥对此表示惊讶和佩服，而皮迪克则被卡门阻止了打斗，随后独自离开去寻找太阳。
[P13] 在阴雨绵绵的天气里，小鸡们在向日葵的指引下，由贝里奥、卡门和卡梅利多带头，四处寻找失踪的太阳，他们担心太阳可能生病甚至已死，画面展现了他们在雨中穿越田野、草地、树林和山洞的场景。
[P14] 在持续一个月的阴雨天里，鸭子柯尔贝在雨中快乐地唱歌跳舞，而小鸡们则无心参与，他们正在寻找失踪的太阳，担心父亲皮迪克会因此失去工作。
[P15] 在雨中，柯尔贝带领小鸡们来到蒙特哥菲尔兄弟的纸张厂房，声称太阳就在楼上。贝里奥询问纸张用途，柯尔贝幽默地回答要写‘鸡同鸭讲’的话，引发小鸡们的惊讶和调侃。
[P16] 小鸡们跟随柯尔贝穿过蒙特哥菲尔兄弟的卧室，发现工作室门被锁上，柯尔贝带领大家从墙上的小洞钻入，成功进入室内。
[P17] 小鸡们在蒙特哥菲尔兄弟的厂房里发现了被绳索束缚的太阳，他们兴奋地奔向太阳，并准备合力将它救出。
[P18] 在蒙特哥菲尔兄弟的厂房内，埃蒂安被吵醒，以为有小粉鸡在偷他们的发明，而约瑟夫则认为他胡思乱想，劝他回去睡觉。
[P19] 小鸡们将被束缚的太阳改装成热气球，气球逐渐膨胀并缓缓升向天空，场面壮观。
[P20] 小鸡、小鸭和小绵羊乘坐由太阳改装成的热气球升上天空，卡门向贝里奥解释天空中的云朵，并感叹地球是圆的，他们俯瞰着下方的家园。
[P21] 在持续的阴雨中，公鸡皮迪克在卡梅拉的陪伴下，最后一次尝试呼唤太阳，他爬上草垛，用尽全力向天空鸣叫，而其他小鸡则在雨中围观，有人幸灾乐祸地预测他不会成功。
[P22] 公鸡皮迪克在草垛上鸣叫后，太阳升起，他欢呼成功；但与此同时，真正的太阳也升起了，小鸡们惊呼并目睹了这一幕。
[P23] 在一个阳光明媚的早晨，皮迪克带着孩子愉快地回家，而其他小鸡则在草地上玩耍，卡门发明了“找太阳”游戏，大家重拾快乐。
[P24] 蒙特哥菲尔兄弟在厂房内争吵，埃蒂安正在为一个黄色气球打气，约瑟夫则指责他找借口，要求他用力打气。
